subject: Cohort onboarding
body:
Welcome pack review

Keep the first page welcoming. We can tell students what to bring without making the Academy sound like a customs checkpoint. Nora's revision distinguishes their laptops from the classroom display equipment.

The setup button needs a working plain-text link beside it. Kira's late email is a good example of a problem that should have been obvious when we checked the pack on a phone.

Payment questions go to Finance; timetable and course questions need the appropriate contact. Please spell that out in the pack instead of relying on students to know our team structure already. Thomas

Maja's new-hire induction pack needs the staff contact list, not the student setup menu. Please check that version alongside this one; the confusing labels seem to have travelled between them.
title: Cohort onboarding
